mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) FROM interview_question WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_question (candidate_id, section, origin, question_type, content, original_content, intent, good_signal, warning_signal, follow_ups, resume_answered_yn, template_id, criterion_id, evidence_id, priority, sort_order, merged, must_ask) VALUES (#{candidateId}, #{section}, #{origin}, #{questionType}, #{content}, #{originalContent}, #{intent}, #{goodSignal}, #{warningSignal}, #{followUps}, #{resumeAnsweredYn}, #{templateId}, #{criterionId}, #{evidenceId}, #{priority}, #{sortOrder}, #{merged}, #{mustAsk})
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_question SET answer = #{answer}, checked = TRUE, answer_excerpt = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND candidate_id = #{candidateId}
UPDATE interview_question SET checked = #{checked} WHERE id = #{id} AND candidate_id = #{candidateId}
UPDATE interview_question SET must_ask = #{mustAsk} WHERE id = #{id} AND candidate_id = #{candidateId}
UPDATE interview_question SET must_ask = #{mustAsk} WHERE template_id = #{templateId}
UPDATE interview_question SET content = #{content} WHERE id = #{id} AND candidate_id = #{candidateId}
UPDATE interview_question SET section = #{section}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id} AND candidate_id = #{candidateId}
UPDATE interview_question SET section = #{section}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, merged = TRUE WHERE id = #{id} AND candidate_id = #{candidateId}
